title: Jerome Ceric – Software Engineer | talfahrt
description: Jerome Ceric, software engineer based near Wuppertal, Germany: Java and Spring Boot, .NET, web apps with React, Supabase and WebGL. Projects, software solutions for companies, and contact.

hero.name: Jerome Ceric
hero.lede: I build software that feels light: web apps for the phone, backends in Java and Spring Boot, and integrations that just run.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: My own web apps, live on talfahrt.dev – designed, built and shipped with AI tools.

gruppetto.description: Prediction game for the Giro, Tour de France and Vuelta: stage picks, bonus scoring, a live table – and 3D mini games in between. Mobile first, installable from the home screen.

rosenherz.description: Clara and Mia inherit Rosenherz Castle and turn it back into a home, room by room. Every room is a 3D dollhouse, every graphic drawn in code, playable offline.

neontd.description: 8 worlds, 48 hand-built tracks, a weekly arena with a global leaderboard. The game logic is written in Java and runs on iPhone, in the browser and as a desktop app.

services.title: Software solutions
services.intro: What I build for companies and teams.

items.title: Web apps that feel like apps
items.text: Fast, offline-capable, launched from the home screen – no app store, no bloat. Made for the phone, good on the desktop.

items.title: Backend and data
items.text: Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Supabase. Clear interfaces, data models you can follow, and permissions that hold.

items.title: Integration and interfaces
items.text: ERP connections, e-invoicing and reporting obligations, data imports that run by themselves at night and tell you in the morning if something is missing.

items.title: Modernisation
items.text: From COBOL, Delphi or SVN to Java, .NET and Git – step by step, without stopping the business.

profile.title: Profile
profile.intro: Jerome Ceric is a software engineer based near Wuppertal, Germany. He builds enterprise software – back-office systems in Java and Spring Boot, integrations with ERP and invoicing systems – and his own web apps with React, Supabase and WebGL.

facts.label: Focus
facts.value: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, .NET, TypeScript, React, Supabase, WebGL

facts.label: Also
facts.value: COBOL, Delphi, Git migrations, e-invoicing (e.g. KSeF), ERP integration (Dynamics 365)

contact.title: Let's talk.
contact.text: For projects, enquiries and everything in between.
